body.purpose: Primary interface copy and dense data rows.

label.purpose: Column headers, section labels, and compact metadata.

code.purpose: Commands, paths, PIDs, ports, addresses, and timestamps.

motion.name: state-standard

components.name: Primary Scan Button
components.description: The high-confidence action for rescanning or saving.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #12a9a8); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent, #12a9a8); color: var(--accent-ink, #021516); font: 700 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.2,1), background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-bright, #22c3bd); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-bright, #22c3bd); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Utility Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action for opening a folder, terminal, or cancelling.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #2b4049); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-raised, #0d1a22); color: var(--text-soft, #c3cdd1); font: 700 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.2,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #11232c); border-color: var(--text-faint, #8799a2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-bright, #22c3bd); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--surface, #0a151c); }

components.name: Destructive Stop Button
components.description: The isolated destructive action after process context has been explained.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--danger, #ff5258); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--danger-soft, rgba(255,82,88,0.08)); color: var(--danger, #ff5258); font: 700 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.2,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger, #ff5258); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--danger, #ff5258); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { filter: brightness(0.9); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The dominant toolbar field for finding folders, processes, ports, and PIDs.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><input aria-label="Rechercher" placeholder="Rechercher un dossier, processus, port, PID…"><kbd>⌘K</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #2b4049); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-raised, #0d1a22); color: var(--text-muted, #8fa1aa); transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.2,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.2,1); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #12a9a8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgba(18,169,168,0.14)); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #eaf0f2); font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-faint, #8799a2); } .ds-search kbd { padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #1d2c34); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-faint, #8799a2); font: 11px SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Active Category Navigation
components.description: The icon-led active state in the persistent left rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; width: 88px; min-height: 76px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-selected-strong, #0d3a42); color: var(--text, #eaf0f2); font: 600 12px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 12px auto 12px 0; width: 2px; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: var(--accent-bright, #22c3bd); } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-nav-active b { position: absolute; top: 9px; right: 14px; min-width: 19px; height: 19px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #1d2c34); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-raised, #0d1a22); color: var(--text-soft, #c3cdd1); font: 700 11px/17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-bright, #22c3bd); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active:active { filter: brightness(0.96); }

components.name: Selected Process Row
components.description: The signature relationship-tree selection band with identity, scope, activity, and evaluation.
components.css: .ds-process-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(270px,1fr) 60px 90px 90px minmax(145px,.55fr); align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; min-height: 54px; padding: 0 18px 0 28px; border: solid rgba(18,169,168,0.45); border-width: 1px 0; background: var(--surface-selected, #0c3037); color: var(--text, #eaf0f2); text-align: left; font: 400 13px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-process-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-width: 0; } .ds-process-name > b { color: var(--text-faint, #8799a2); } .ds-process-name > i { color: #55bd73; font: 700 15px SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-process-name strong, .ds-process-name small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-process-name small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--text-faint, #8799a2); font-size: 11px; } .ds-process-row code { font: 12px SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-activity { display: inline-flex; align-items: end; gap: 2px; height: 15px; } .ds-activity i { width: 3px; background: var(--success, #24c979); } .ds-activity i:nth-child(1) { height: 4px; } .ds-activity i:nth-child(2) { height: 7px; } .ds-activity i:nth-child(3) { height: 10px; } .ds-activity i:nth-child(4) { height: 13px; } .ds-activity i:nth-child(5) { height: 15px; background: var(--line-strong, #2b4049); } .ds-eval { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-soft, #c3cdd1); font-size: 12px; } .ds-eval i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--warning, #f3ad25); } .ds-process-row:hover { background: var(--surface-selected-strong, #0d3a42); } .ds-process-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-bright, #22c3bd); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-process-row:active { filter: brightness(0.95); }

components.name: Process Origin Card
components.description: The inspector's key explanatory object connecting a process to its working folder.
components.css: .ds-origin { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0,1fr) 30px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 10px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(18,169,168,0.14)); color: var(--accent-bright, #22c3bd); } .ds-origin > svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-origin div { min-width: 0; } .ds-origin strong, .ds-origin code { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-origin strong { color: var(--text, #eaf0f2); font: 700 13px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-origin code { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--text-muted, #8fa1aa); font: 10px/1.4 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; white-space: normal; } .ds-origin button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #2b4049); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-raised, #0d1a22); color: var(--text-muted, #8fa1aa); } .ds-origin button svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-origin button:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #11232c); color: var(--text, #eaf0f2); } .ds-origin button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-bright, #22c3bd); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-origin button:active { filter: brightness(0.92); }

components.name: Operational Status
components.description: A compact semantic dot-and-label status rather than a filled badge.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--text-muted, #8fa1aa); font: 400 11px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success, #24c979); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(36,201,121,0); transition: box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.2,1); } .ds-status:hover i { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(36,201,121,0.14); } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-bright, #22c3bd); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
PortRoot should feel like a purpose-built instrument on a developer's desk: quiet, exact, and ready for sustained daily use. Its density is deliberate. Graphite planes suppress visual noise so relationships, live state, risk, and origin can be read in one pass without turning the interface into a generic monitoring dashboard.

The visual world is relationship-first rather than widget-first. A persistent category rail, a structured process tree, a technical inspector, and a slim status strip form one continuous operating surface. Color is rare and semantic: teal marks current focus, green indicates healthy activity, amber requests review, red communicates exposure or destruction, and lavender marks protected system state.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, relationship-first process and port hierarchy
Full-height desktop composition with persistent controls and inspector
Dark graphite default with an accessible semantic light remap
Teal focus, green activity, amber review, red danger, and lavender protection
Native UI typography paired with tabular monospace machine data
Thin seams and tonal planes instead of decorative card stacks

rules.name: The Semantic Rarity Rule
rules.body: Teal, green, amber, red, and lavender must explain state; do not use them to decorate empty space.

rules.name: The Risk Is Red Rule
rules.body: Red belongs to network exposure, destructive affordances, destructive confirmation, and errors—never ordinary selection or benign emphasis.

rules.name: The Protection Is Lavender Rule
rules.body: Lavender always means protected system state or a safety barrier; this consistent meaning makes blocked actions legible at a glance.

rules.name: The Machine Data Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when exact symbols or numeric alignment improve verification; process names and explanatory prose stay in the native sans family.

rules.name: The Dense but Legible Rule
rules.body: Rows may be compact, but primary identity stays at 13–14px and tertiary labels never replace the main text contrast level.

rules.name: The One-Frame Rule
rules.body: Search, filtering, process relationships, selected-process context, available actions, and scan status must remain accessible in the first viewport.

rules.name: The Relationship Rail Rule
rules.body: Preserve indentation guides and aligned columns; hierarchy must be understood spatially before users read every label.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Resting application planes use tone and seams; shadows are reserved for overlays and transient surfaces that truly sit above the workbench.

rules.name: The Rows Stay Rows Rule
rules.body: Do not round each process or port into a card; selection is a continuous band inside the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Radius Tracks Elevation Rule
rules.body: Flat controls are compact, signature icon tiles are slightly softer, and only true overlays receive the largest corners.

dos: **Do** preserve the category rail → relationship tree → technical inspector hierarchy from `design/reference-dark.png`.
**Do** make working directory, duplicate instances, activity, network scope, and protection state scannable without opening a second screen.
**Do** keep dark mode as the default and maintain equivalent semantic roles, contrast, and hierarchy in light and system modes.
**Do** use native sans typography for interface language and tabular monospace for commands, paths, PIDs, ports, addresses, and timestamps.
**Do** enforce a visible 2px teal focus outline, keyboard access, independent interior scrolling, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** separate destructive controls visually and require the confirmation surface before a stop request.
donts: **Don't** flatten the application → process family → port relationship into an anonymous socket table.
**Don't** introduce floating dashboard cards, gradients, glass effects, decorative shadows, or oversized hero typography.
**Don't** use semantic accents interchangeably; teal is focus, green is activity, amber is review, red is risk/destruction, and lavender is protection.
**Don't** round every row or replace the branch structure with disconnected tiles.
**Don't** hide the working-folder origin behind secondary interaction or place stop controls before explanatory context.
**Don't** treat the browser's demonstration data as live scan output; keep the demo status explicit wherever that preview state is shown.
